articles.content:

Yumeya describes a playful “bag from a bag” concept. These are bag-shaped pouches rather than character figures, and the maker specifically presents them as a way to separate small belongings. The visual theme is gothic, matching My Melody and Kuromi.

articles.content:

  • Release listing: January 2025, week 2

The series is made to hug a cable with a small character mascot. The official listing gives an important limitation: it is not designed to prevent cable breakage or provide cable protection. Fit also depends on the cable size.

The six character labels shown for this edition are Cinnamoroll, Pochacco, Hangyodon, Pompompurin, Kuromi, and My Melody. The “little devil” theme refers to the winged character styling on the official release.
